title: Crispy Bean Pilaf
description: A simple Chinese-inspired dish made with crispy bean pilaf and crunchy vegetables.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of warm oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped Syrian and pinto beans, cook for 2-3 minutes until they start to brown.
Add the crispy pilaf and stir to combine with the beans.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the pilaf is heated through.
Transfer to a serving platter and garnish with additional crispy pilaf if desired.
